E-R1-EXIT-01.assertion: exact tarball, dependency/export/file tuple, generated guidance, offline install/import, and SSR pass

E-R1-EXIT-02.assertion: sha256, npm shasum, integrity, source revision, and preparation-tool identity are recorded; registry provenance remains pending

E-R1-EXIT-03.assertion: requires a separately authorized npm publication and clean published-package consumer verification

E-R1-EXIT-04.assertion: next dist-tag observation; rollback prepared, not exercised: verifies next, confirms latest is not claimed, and confirms the fix-forward path is ready

guidance.correlation: all generated/package guidance resolves to the exact candidate package tuple

checks.command: npm trusted publishing: OIDC from .github/workflows/npm-publish.yml in the npm-publish environment
checks.name: namespace ownership
checks.policy: only the trusted publisher configured for @muxui/react can publish; there is no long-lived token, and a mismatched workflow, environment, or repository fails authentication before any write

checks.name: version collision
checks.policy: an existing version is a hard stop; never overwrite or republish it

checks.laterPublish: record the prior next and latest pointers; after publication next must be the candidate and latest unchanged
checks.name: next dist-tag collision
checks.policy: a first publish expects the package to be absent and must be 0.1.0-rc.1; otherwise the dist-tags must be exactly latest and next, next must be a published rc.N and this candidate the next number, rc.N+1, and latest is recorded unchanged; any other dist-tag state is a hard stop for review

checks.command: GET https://registry.npmjs.org/@muxui/react (dist-tags), immediately before npm publish
checks.name: publish authorization drift
checks.policy: npm-publish environment approval gates the publish job; recheck the recorded registry state immediately before npm publish and stop on drift

notReleaseProof: Storybook manager, docs, onboarding, and create-story colour proofs (muxui:decision:0030)

forbidden: overwrite or republish the immutable package version
unpublish, except for a security or legal problem inside the npm 72-hour no-dependents window with explicit human authorization
claim or promote latest, other than the separately authorized fix-forward re-point from 0.1.0-rc.4 to 0.1.0-rc.5; the registry sets latest on first publish
steps: stop further publication and preserve the immutable 0.1.0-rc.4 version and manifest
with Andrew's separate explicit authorization, run npm deprecate on @muxui/react@0.1.0-rc.4 with a message naming the failure and its fixed successor
fix forward by publishing a corrected 0.1.0-rc.5 to next through a separately authorized publication
optional, only after 0.1.0-rc.5 is verified and with Andrew's separate explicit authorization at the time: re-point latest from the deprecated 0.1.0-rc.4 to 0.1.0-rc.5
retain the candidate artifact and failed verification for audit; latest is otherwise not claimed or promoted (the registry sets latest on first publish) and stable is not promoted

provenance.intent: source, generated projections, and provenance sidecars are correlated; registry provenance is not claimed by local preparation
